text:
jamie_support: FYI customers started hitting p99 spikes for long-form generation after we swapped to v3-bpe yesterday afternoon. Several support tickets opened.
eli_eng: saw it too, p95 also up ~30% on long inputs (>8k tokens). Not universal but a lot of traffic from doc-summarize flows.
tanvi_ml: any tokenizer changes in the v3-bpe rollout? We changed merge table and fallback normalization last deploy.
eli_eng: yes, two changes: (1) new BPE merges to reduce vocab, (2) stricter cjk normalization. Both were in the model artifact we pulled.
jamie_support: examples from customer A: requests that used to be 450ms p99 now show 1.6s p99 and some 504 timeouts from clients.
ravi_sre: can you paste a repro curl and a short failing prompt? I'll try to reproduce on staging.
jamie_support: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"v3-bpe","input":"<20000 char doc>"}'
eli_eng: repro locally with the same doc: I see tokenization step taking ~400-600ms on CPU path before handing to runtime; previously it was ~80-100ms. That explains the extra tail.
tanvi_ml: that points at tokenizer path, not serving kernels. Did we accidentally route tokenization to slower worker for long inputs?
eli_eng: config shows tokenizer.process_timeout bumped from 500ms -> 1500ms in the deploy config by mistake (intended only for small-token batches). Also fallback normalization was doing full Unicode normalization on the whole doc, O(n) heavy.
dave_product: customers care about p99; we need mitigation plan and ETA. Ops please advise routing fallback.
ravi_sre: immediate mitigations we can do: (A) hotfix config: revert process_timeout and normalization flag (low-risk), (B) pin high-volume customers to v2-bpe (older model) via routing policy, (C) enable tokenization service autoscale and threadpool bump for 24h.
eli_eng: I'll push hotfix for normalization flag within the hour and update the deploy config to the previous tokenizer worker mapping.
tanvi_ml: I'll prepare a quick rollback patch for the merge table (if needed) but prefer config fix first. Merge table itself is not obviously the culprit.
jamie_support: I'll tell customers: "we're rolling a config hotfix that should reduce tokenization latency within 1h. If you still see issues, we'll pin you to v2-bpe temporarily."
opsbot: deploy-bot: Started rollout of tokenizer-config-hotfix to staging at 3332110500.
ravi_sre: after hotfix, we should monitor p95/p99 for rolling window 5m and alerts at 2x baseline. Also add a synthetic long-doc test to Canary (10k/20k tokens).
eli_eng: added synthetic tests to CI: long-doc-10k and 20k. Running now.
tanvi_ml: for post-mortem we should collect tokenization histograms by input-length, and compare normalization CPU vs mem.
dave_product: assign owners: eli_eng owns fix and verification; ravi_sre owns rollout and routing; tanvi_ml owns root cause analysis; jamie_support will handle customer comms and ticket updates.
jamie_support: updating ticket threads and sending email to top impacted customers with ETA ~60m. :email:
eli_eng: quick note — we might also hit increased KV-cache misses if token boundaries change; will validate outputs against v2-bpe for regression.
ravi_sre: good call. If output diffs are acceptable, pinning to v2-bpe is fine. Otherwise we may need to do a canary compare.
jamie_support: customer B reported a billing error 402 when retrying after timeout — likely independent but I'll open separate follow-up.
eli_eng: staging hotfix results: tokenization step down from ~500ms -> ~90ms on 20k doc, end-to-end p99 dropped from 1.6s -> 480ms.
opsbot: deploy-bot: Hotfix promoted to production at 3332112600.
ravi_sre: monitoring shows p99 back near historical baseline for affected routes. I'm keeping routing to v2-bpe off for now.
jamie_support: I'll close immediate escalations after confirming with customers in 2 hours.
tanvi_ml: next steps for RCA doc: timeline of changes, diff of tokenizer config, perf regression numbers, decision tree for when to change normalization. I'll write that and link to the postmortem.
dave_product: thanks team. For follow-up, create a canary that compares tokenization cost before accepting merge-table changes. Otherwise we risk repeat.
eli_eng: agreed — adding tokenization profiling gating into model onboarding checklist.
jamie_support: closing loop with customers now. :thumbsup:
